title: Adaptation algorithms for selecting personalised learning experience based on learning style and dyslexia type
reason: Describes adaptation algorithms of a dyslexia-adaptive e-learning system (DAELMS) using ILS learning style and dyslexia type. An evaluation with 48 students is mentioned but its results are 'under process for publications'; no data reported.

extraction.country: Saudi Arabia (King Abdulaziz University; study site not stated)
extraction.design: system design; evaluation announced but not reported
extraction.n_quote: students studying a computer science-related majors. There were 48 students participating
extraction.population: computer-science university students (11 dyslexic, 23 with symptoms, 14 non-dyslexic)
extraction.notes: Secondary code: NOREL. NONEMP applied because the paper presents no empirical results (precedence NONEMP > NOREL).
